_layer: SCRIPT LAYER output — authored with references/dialogue-action-framework.md ONLY.
_about: Ordered dialogue+action beats. Each beat is one spoken line plus the action performed while saying it. build_ad.py groups consecutive beats into clips of <=10s of speech and stitches them. Production fields (look, lighting, camera) live in the brief, NOT here.
hook_type: Curiosity | Contrarian | Social Proof | Story | Demographic | Result | Pattern Interrupt | Fascinating Fact

beats.dialogue: <HOOK line — stop the scroll in the first 3 seconds>
beats.action: <what the speaker physically does while saying it>

beats.dialogue: <PROBLEM line — the pain the viewer feels>
<MECHANISM line — what the product does, shown in-scene on a real device if relevant>
beats.action: <paired action, e.g. tipping head toward the open laptop>
<paired action, e.g. a warm shrug and easy smile>

_seconds_note: Set 'seconds' on a beat only to override the auto estimate (~2.5 words/sec). Leave null to auto-estimate. A single beat should stay well under 10s of speech.
